desktop_timing.excludes: disk, utterance duration, wake, VAD, 400ms endpoint wait, device execution
desktop_timing.includes: in-memory WAV decode, frontend, CPU ONNX with one thread, direct single-process finite scoring

fp32.mode: single complete-utterance inference after VAD endpoint; no streaming caches
